phase: I — Indirect + hidden tests (8 agents parallel)
mission: Code-static deep-dive on side-effect side-channels per user action — audit_logs, cache invalidations, Echo broadcasts, queued jobs, file writes, external API calls, updated_at touches. Flag silently swallowed failures.
scope: 10 most-frequent user actions traced through controller/service/listener call graph
method: Grep for event(new ...), broadcast(...), Cache::forget(, Log::warning(, try{...}catch, dispatch(...), Queue::push(, Notification::send(. Per callsite, classified as ENFORCED (rethrows / 5xx) or SILENT-SWALLOW (try/catch → Log::warning → continue).

H1_AuditLogService_write_failure_path.production_impact: Silent NF525 chain GAPS are possible at cash drawer session events (open/close/reconcile/movement), delivery boy cash events, login/logout events. The DB-layer immutability (no-delete triggers) protects the EXISTING rows but missing-write events are unrecoverable. Mitigated by: (1) FiscalChainValidator periodic verifyChain, (2) Log::warning grep in ops, (3) DB unique constraints prevent duplicate retries. Compliance risk: missing audit events for cash sessions during ops review = audit finding. V1 LOCAL Le Cayenne ACCEPTABLE per documented intent; V2 SaaS multi-tenant requires alerting pipeline.

verdict_rationale: V1 LOCAL Le Cayenne is SHIPPABLE — the silent-swallow pattern is consistently DOCUMENTED with explicit intent comments and the dominant invariants (NF525 fiscal_sequence_no allocation, payment_status flip, OrderCreated outbox-first) ARE enforced inside DB transactions and rollback on failure. However, 22 silent-swallow callsites form an unmonitored degradation surface: when ANY of them fire, ops has no signal except grepping Log::warning manually. The top 3 (OrderStateMachine recordTransition, CashDrawer writeAuditLog, Login/Logout audit) are NF525-adjacent and warrant V1.0.2 metric+alert pipeline before V2 multi-tenant SaaS rollout. ZERO V1 SHIP BLOCKERS — all swallows are downstream best-effort; the upstream DB invariants are intact.
